blocks.text: Sab se aam physical khatraat geele farsh par kaam karte hue phisalna aur girna hain; kaam karne wale ko phisalne, kheenchne aur girne jaise physical khatraat se mutalliq hadson se bachne ke liye har qism ki ehtiyaat karni chahiye. Toota sheeshe ka saman sambhalte waqt kat lagne, khirchon aur jild ke nuqsan se bachne ko cut-resistant dastane pehnein, aur laboratory staff ke liye lazim ho ke chot se bachne ko toota sheesha khaas container mein phenka jaye.

blocks.caption: Physical khatraat aur ehtiyaat
rows: phisalne aur girne se bachein; kheenchte ya uthate waqt khayal
cut-resistant dastane; khaas container mein phenkein; tootna report karein (16.1)

blocks.prompt: Ek test tube mez par toot jati hai. Aage kya hona chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Tootna lab incharge ko foran report karein, tukron ko chhoone se pehle cut-resistant dastane pehnein, aur toota sheesha sheeshe ke khaas container mein dalein, aam koore ke dabbe mein kabhi nahi.

items: Physical khatraat: phisalna aur girna (geela farsh), toote sheeshe se kat; cut-resistant dastane aur toote sheeshe ke liye khaas container.
